CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION marathon.agenda_presentes(p uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$select count(*)::int from marathon.turnos where plan_id=p and estado='PRESENTE'$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION marathon.agenda_total(p uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$select coalesce(sum(cantidad),0)::int from marathon.agenda_autorizaciones where plan_id=p$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION marathon.agenda_virtual(d date)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, plan_id uuid, horario_id uuid, dni text, sede text, profesional_id text, terapia_id text, hora time without time zone, duracion_min integer, pausado boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select 'H-'||h.id::text||'-'||d::text,p.id,h.id,p.dni,h.sede,h.profesional_id,p.terapia_id,h.hora,h.duracion_min,marathon.agenda_pausado(p.id,d)
 from marathon.agenda_horarios h join marathon.agenda_planes p on p.id=h.plan_id
 where h.dia=extract(dow from d)::int and d>=greatest(h.desde,p.inicio) and(h.hasta is null or d<h.hasta) and(p.baja is null or d<p.baja)
 and(p.modalidad<>'sessions' or marathon.agenda_presentes(p.id)<marathon.agenda_total(p.id))
 and not exists(select 1 from marathon.turnos t where t.horario_id=h.id and t.fecha_habitual=d)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION marathon.session_minutes(d date, site text, prof text, start_time time without time zone, requested integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select least(requested,coalesce((select (extract(epoch from (max(h.fin)-start_time))/60)::integer
 from marathon.horarios h where h.profesional_id=prof and h.sede=site and h.dia=extract(dow from d)::int and h.inicio<=start_time and start_time<h.fin),requested));
$function$
